cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/harness.py <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys,os,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from wire import *
def run(traces):
    inp=json.dumps({'traces':traces if isinstance(traces,list) else [traces]})
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/workspace/run.py','/workspace/tmp/classes'],input=inp.encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if p.returncode: print('EXIT',p.returncode,p.stderr.decode()); return None
    return json.loads(p.stdout)
if __name__=='__main__':
    pass
PY
